settings.title: Curious
settings.text: We ask why it's done that way, and whether it has to be. Most of the time it doesn't.

settings.title: Economical
settings.text: Good things shouldn't cost a fortune. The first thing we built is free.

settings.title: Good for the world
settings.text: If there's a version that's kinder to people and the planet, that's the one we make.
